hero.headline: Great product. *Quiet brand.* Here's how we fix that.
hero.intro: A full breakdown of where Northwind's brand and channels stand today, what you're not doing yet, what's missing, and exactly what elevraa. would change in the next 90 days. Built to be reviewed, argued with, and edited.

summary.verdict: Northwind wins almost every deal it gets into. The problem is it **isn't in enough deals**. Buyers in your category know Mixpanel and Amplitude by name; they find Northwind by accident. The fix isn't more ads. It's becoming the name buyers already trust before they start shopping.

goals.goal: Build founder and leadership presence on LinkedIn
Generate demos from mid-market product teams
Turn customer wins into sales assets
Make the website convert the traffic you already get

scorecard.note: VP Sales and CPO not posting
Logos, but no stories or numbers

working.title: Founder shows up every week
working.detail: Three to four posts a week with a loyal core audience. The habit is there; the angle needs sharpening.

working.title: Product is genuinely loved
working.detail: 4.8 on G2 with specific, emotional reviews. That's raw material most brands would pay for.

working.title: Clear ICP on paper
working.detail: Mid-market product teams, 50-500 employees. Sales knows exactly who buys.

notDoing.title: Activating the leadership team
notDoing.detail: Only one voice posting means one source of trust. Buyers want to hear from the people they'll actually work with.

notDoing.title: Telling customer stories
notDoing.detail: Wins live in Slack and sales calls, never on the timeline or the website.

notDoing.title: Owning a point of view
notDoing.detail: Content explains features. Nobody is saying what Northwind believes about how product teams should work.

notDoing.title: Warming target accounts before outreach
notDoing.detail: Sales cold-emails accounts that have never seen the brand.

missing.title: A one-line positioning statement
missing.detail: Homepage, LinkedIn bios and the sales deck each describe Northwind differently.

missing.title: Case studies with numbers
missing.detail: Zero published. Every competitor has at least five.

missing.title: A lead magnet worth trading an email for
missing.detail: No guide, benchmark or template that captures intent from content readers.

missing.title: Attribution from content to pipeline
missing.detail: No way to see which posts or pages influence demos.

channels.name: LinkedIn
channels.summary: The founder's habit is strong. We turn it into thought leadership and add three more credible voices.
audit: **Consistent posting** from the founder, 3-4 times a week. Cadence is not the problem.
**Content is product-led.** Most posts announce features or releases, which buyers scroll past.
**Leadership is silent.** VP Sales and CPO have strong profiles and zero recent posts.
**No long-form thinking.** Nothing that shows how Northwind sees the future of product analytics.

plan.title: Four content pillars
plan.detail: Point-of-view takes, customer proof, behind-the-build, and practical playbooks.

plan.title: Executive track
plan.detail: Bi-weekly 30-minute interview with each leader; we write, they approve.

plan.title: Repurposing system
plan.detail: Every webinar and blog becomes 3-5 native LinkedIn posts within 48 hours.

channels.name: Website
channels.summary: Traffic is healthy; the message doesn't do it justice.
audit: **Hero headline lists features** instead of the outcome product teams want.
**No proof above the fold.** Logos sit at the bottom of the page.
**One call to action** (book a demo) with nothing for visitors who aren't ready yet.

plan.title: Outcome-led homepage
plan.detail: Rewrite hero, sub-copy and section flow around the buyer's problem.

plan.title: Proof everywhere
plan.detail: Case study snippets and G2 quotes on every key page.

plan.title: Second conversion path
plan.detail: A benchmark report as a lead magnet for earlier-stage visitors.

channels.name: Customer proof
channels.summary: Your best sales asset isn't being used.
audit: **Zero case studies** published despite 40+ happy customers.
**G2 reviews are strong** but never quoted in content or sales materials.

plan.title: Three hero case studies
plan.detail: Interview, write and design stories with real numbers.

plan.title: Proof library
plan.detail: Quotes, stats and screenshots sales can drop into any deck or email.

channels.name: ABM
channels.summary: Stop cold outreach to strangers. Warm the 100 accounts that matter first.
audit: **Generic sequences** sent to broad lists, 2% reply rate.
**No coordination** between content and sales on target accounts.

plan.title: Warm-up sequence
plan.detail: Targeted content and engagement for 3 weeks before any outreach.

services.title: Positioning & messaging
services.detail: One sharp story that every channel, page and rep tells the same way.

services.title: Founder & executive LinkedIn
services.detail: Done-for-you content for four voices, built from real conversations.

services.title: Creative ABM & proof
services.detail: Warm your top accounts and arm sales with stories that close.

roadmap.title: Foundation
items: Founder content moves to the new pillars
roadmap.outcome: One clear story, four voices ready, founder content live on the new angle.

roadmap.title: Momentum
roadmap.outcome: Brand shows up in more feeds, with proof on the site.

roadmap.title: Pipeline
roadmap.outcome: A repeatable engine with at least one deal traced back to this plan.

outcomes.label: More voices building trust on LinkedIn
Case studies sales can use today

needs: A 60-minute positioning workshop with the founder and leadership
Access to LinkedIn company page and analytics
Introductions to 3 customers for case study interviews
Your current ICP and target account list
A Slack channel shared with the team
One point person for approvals (48-hour turnaround)

investment.sub: Sample pricing for the template. Replace with real numbers per proposal.
investment.note: Three-month minimum so the roadmap has room to compound.

cta.title: Let's make Northwind the *obvious choice*.
cta.text: A 30-minute call to walk through this plan, pressure-test it against your numbers, and agree on what ships first.
